title: Analysis code for: Global intron retention burden in glioma: a cross-cohort computational analysis of splicing structure, spliceosome coupling and clinical correlates
description: Complete analysis code (44 Python, 16 R scripts) for the study of global intron retention burden in TCGA glioblastoma and lower-grade glioma, including pan-cancer validation across 31 tumour types (8,266 tumours) and replication with an independent PSI quantification pipeline (TCGASpliceSeq). Input data are public (TCGA, CGGA, GTEx, Kahles 2018 pan-cancer splicing atlas) and are not redistributed here; see README section 2.

creators.name: Ma, Peng
creators.affiliation: Department of Neurosurgery, Taicang Loujiang New City Hospital (Ruijin Hospital Taicang Branch), Taicang, China

notes: Scripts 55 and 56 are superseded exploratory versions retained for provenance; script 57 is the definitive cross-pipeline replication. See README section 1.
